card.name: Words completing common English phrases
card.fires_on: A content word in general web prose that comes right after a determiner or possessive and completes a familiar idiom or phrase, such as "the will of", "at the expense of", "wrinkle our noses". It is not tied to drug-label text.

modes.label: Idiom completion
modes.description: Noun or adjective finishing a set phrase that is about to continue with 'of' or a similar word.
modes.example: This optimizes typing at the<< expense>> of reading.

modes.label: Verb or noun after possessive
modes.description: Word following 'your', 'our' or 'you' in everyday advice or opinion writing.
